provenance.author_meaning: Owner-delegated initialization recorded by the coordinator; no human assessment or completion is asserted.

payload.title: OPHANIM planning fundamentals
payload.goal: Learn to derive and evaluate what a plan requires through six hypothetical learning phases.

acceptance.prompt: A human acknowledges the separate assessor's evidence from an unfamiliar uncoached transfer exercise and its demonstrated limits. Initialization, coaching feedback and document existence do not satisfy this criterion.

constraints: OPHANIM is the learner; one exercise at a time.
Preserve original attempts, hints, revisions, evidence and negative outcomes in docs/planning/LEARNING_PROGRESS.md.
The coach must create the next itinerary at every assessment handoff and session end, including prerequisites and pass/block/stop conditions.
Qualitative learning criteria require assessment; the board schema does not prove understanding.
Initialization only: no worker, background scheduler, provider or experiment is started.
Use existing public board APIs for subsequent state changes with the expected current commit; never edit refs or stored objects directly.
forbidden: No paid calls, implicit provider dispatch or invented numeric budget.
No project implementation tickets, optimization, release or authority changes.
No fabricated completion, automatic advancement or self-certified final transfer.
Do not pass this learning board to the build runner or OPHANIM's synthetic proof runtime.

payload.title: Frame the problem
payload.next_action: OPHANIM records an unassisted answer to the first lesson in FUNDAMENTALS.md before the coach gives a hint.
assessment_criteria: Distinguish the objective from a method.
State observable success and the learning-only boundary.
Identify missing information that changes success.

payload.title: Ground the reasoning

block.reason: Phase 1 criteria need evidence; the coach must supply a versioned fictional fact packet.

assessment_criteria: Trace material claims to supplied facts or label them assumptions/unknowns.
Do not turn missing capacity or availability into a favorable fact.

payload.title: Derive necessary work

block.reason: Phase 2 distinctions need evidence; a versioned flawed plan exercise must be supplied.

assessment_criteria: Explain the outcome or consumer served by each retained step.
Justify removal, merging and ordering through actual dependencies.

payload.title: Test adequacy and failure

block.reason: Phase 3 dependency reasoning needs evidence before introducing a changed constraint or cancellation.

assessment_criteria: Identify affected assumptions and dependencies while preserving constraints.
Provide recovery/stop conditions and independently checkable success or failure evidence.

payload.title: Judge further investigation

block.reason: Phase 4 adequacy reasoning needs evidence; investigation choices and missing-cost cases must be supplied.

assessment_criteria: Name the decision additional learning could change and a discriminating observation.
Separate requirements, information value and authority.
Retain justified no_change or insufficient_evidence outcomes.

payload.title: Demonstrate transfer independently

block.reason: Earlier criteria need evidence; a separate assessor must supply an unfamiliar case and assess an uncoached answer.

assessment_criteria: Explain necessary and sufficient work, dependencies, feasibility, uncertainty and verification.
Revise coherently when one condition changes.
Record specific independent evidence and limits; preserve insufficient evidence if assessment is unavailable.
